rows.delivery_billing_rules: Bill global only same QHP/TIN; otherwise separate split maternity services and newborns require modifier 59.
Includes delivery globally; admissions within 72 hours bundled; mixed deliveries pay cesarean 100%, vaginal 50%.
Multiple births: subsequent vaginal deliveries pay 50%; modifier 59/22 applies; sterilization requires timed consent.
Multiple births: first vaginal delivery 100%, additional 50% with modifier 59; cesareans use modifier 22.
Allows split OB billing; combined delivery/postpartum billing; multiple-procedure reductions, including 50% secondary deliveries.
Bundle routine OB; bill one single-gestation unit, using delivery+postpartum when same group provides both.

reimbursement_policies.evidence: On-topic maternity policy. Vaginal delivery is included in delivery reimbursement, and when global obstetric care is billed by the same provider or provider group under the same TIN, antepartum, delivery, and postpartum services are bundled into one global payment. Duplicate or overlapping maternity services are not separately reimbursed.

state_specific_rules: GA: maternity ultrasounds included in global package unless problem-oriented
KY: maternity ultrasounds included in global package unless problem-oriented
OH: more than two ultrasounds not separately reimbursed unless problem-oriented
VA: more than two ultrasounds not separately reimbursed unless problem-oriented
exemptions: maternity ultrasounds related to problem oriented diagnosis

reimbursement_policies.evidence: Global vaginal delivery is bundled with antepartum, delivery, and postpartum maternity services when billed by the same qualified provider or same TIN.

utilization_limits: additional antepartum visits only if >13 visits
provider_role_restrictions: same qualified provider or same TIN
exemptions: pregnancy confirmation visit when OB record is not initiated

reimbursement_policies.evidence: Delivery-related inpatient maternity care is bundled into the global obstetric package and is not separately reimbursed. Routine vaginal delivery is included, while separate payment applies only when partial-care maternity CPTs are reported.

Multiple-birth vaginal delivery claims are reimbursed at 100% for the primary procedure and 50% for secondary procedures when a multiple gestation diagnosis is reported and at least one delivery is vaginal.

The policy does not provide a DRG-based inpatient facility payment rule for this vaginal delivery DRG description. It does provide related professional maternity billing rules for multiple births: vaginal deliveries in multiple births are allowed when billed with modifier 59, and each subsequent vaginal delivery is reimbursed at 50% of the allowance. No separate Texas-specific reimbursement methodology beyond applicability/effective date is stated.

utilization_limits: 50% of allowance for each subsequent vaginal delivery
state_specific_rules: TX: initial approval and effective 01/01/2025.
exemptions: provider, state, or federal contracts/mandates indicate otherwise

reimbursement_policies.evidence: The policy is maternity-related but does not directly address this DRG title. It governs reimbursement for multiple births in vaginal or cesarean deliveries, requiring Modifier 59 for vaginal deliveries, paying subsequent vaginal deliveries at 50% of the allowance, and using Modifier 22 with documentation review for cesarean deliveries when additional reimbursement is warranted.

This is a maternity reimbursement policy, not a DRG policy. Vaginal-delivery maternity services are paid under global OB rules, with antepartum, delivery, and postpartum care bundled unless split-package criteria apply.

state_specific_rules: Texas plans birthing center: report 59409 for all babies
provider_role_restrictions: one physician, one midwife, or same group practice

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Obstetrical Policy, Professional - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: This policy does not assign or price inpatient facility DRGs, but it governs the professional side of vaginal delivery through global OB CPT coding. When the same group provides antepartum, delivery, and postpartum care, 59400 is used and routine prenatal, delivery, inpatient within 24 hours of delivery, and routine postpartum services are bundled. Separate payment is allowed only for listed exclusions such as high-risk or complication E/M with modifier 25, confirmatory pregnancy visit with Z32.01 if no OB record is started, labs other than 81000/81002, ultrasound 76801-76828, non-OB care, inpatient E/M more than 24 hours before delivery, and unrelated critical care with modifier FT.

This policy addresses sterilization reimbursement, not the delivery DRG itself. Sterilization is not reimbursable unless necessary for treatment of illness or injury or otherwise required by contract; if performed with delivery, multiple surgery guidelines apply and consent rules must be met.

reimbursement_policies.evidence: Sterilization procedures are reimbursable only with valid informed consent and required documentation. When sterilization is performed with delivery, multiple surgery rules apply. Tennessee Medicaid facility claims are not reimbursed when sterilization accompanies caesarean delivery or vaginal delivery under DRG methodology.

reimbursement_policies.evidence: Texas Medicaid professional OB billing requires unbundled maternity services rather than global OB billing. Vaginal delivery-only code 59409 is payable only under state-specific conditions, including required modifiers and same-day birthing center/provider claim rules.

TX: prenatal E/M codes require TH
TX: delivery codes require U1, U2, or U3
TX: U3 is not reimbursable

provider_role_restrictions: Same Group Physician and/or Other Qualified Health Care Professional

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: Bundle 59510, 59514, and 59515 into the global maternity package when billed on the same delivery admission, after delivery, and within 72 hours of delivery; if the same group physician/QHP did not provide the total OB package, do not pay global 59510 and instead require 59425 for 4-6 antepartum visits, 59426 for 7 or more visits, or 59430 for postpartum care only within 6 weeks postpartum. Exempt: complications of pregnancy, multiple gestation. Peer: BCBS_TX, Cigna, Moda, and United Health all use 59425/59426/59430 as split-package maternity codes instead of paying a single global service when care is fragmented..

Recommendation 2: When 58600, 58605, 58611, or 58615 are reported during a cesarean admission, allow payment only in conjunction with delivery and on the same claim with multiple surgery, with a valid consent form and consent 30 to 180 days before the procedure or within 72 hours for premature delivery. Peer: Elevance internal and external sterilization policies both require 58600/58605/58611/58615 to be billed in conjunction with delivery, with timed consent guardrails..
